name: H04_response_patient_rl

response_config.reward: unchanged status function of point glucose forecast; not E[r(G)] under predictive uncertainty

adaptations: fR and reference fT/fP retain full-Loop and matched simulator training from H02; no original data removed
fT decomposes reference trajectory and learned causal convolution responses of glucose and latent state; local conditional linear time-invariance is a testable assumption
response coefficients trained only from same-state paired intervention labels, not confounded factual action correlations
reward uses unchanged status function applied to predicted point glucose, removing independent head inconsistency; nonlinear expected-risk calibration not established
pi initialized from H02 full policy epoch; one additional full Loop policy epoch at same seed with bounded-return NLL objective; matched unchanged-H02 extra-policy control
reference basal reconstructed from last recorded history in original units, never simulator nominal parameters; missing reference is only a coordinate origin, not a fallback dose
selection: fixed response100epochs without development checkpoint selection; full additional policy epoch; control assessed independently
